input.quote: (iii) the collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data), to the extent collected, directed by, maintained or stored by Kubient, as well as the performance of the Auction Platform, is and shall be in a secure manner using best practices of security technology
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns nothing, and the General Provisions (Section 14, p0063–p0073) contain no coverage or certificate-of-insurance requirement. Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and, per its own warranty at p0035, collects, maintains and stores visitor data, so it is squarely a services/hosting vendor touching our data — the walk-away scenario of no insurance for a vendor processing personal data. We therefore insert a short insurance covenant at the preferred levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request) as new Section 14(j), with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (j)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance requirement even though Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and collects and stores visitor data, so we have added our standard coverage levels (CGL, E&O and cyber liability) with certificates on request. If helpful, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, to the extent Kubient collects, stores, processes or otherwise has access to Customer data or visitor information, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Kubient shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
